description: Consommation annuelle brute régionale is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente les consommations nationales annuelles brutes d’électricité (GWh) et de gaz (GWh PCS 0°C). Concernant les données Electricité: Périmètre: France continentale et Corse, pertes comprises avec et sans correction de l'aléa climatique. Suite à un recalcul de l'autoconsommation photovoltaïque, la consommation sur les années 2022 à 2024 a augmenté. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Consommation, Territoires et régions. Its keywords are Tableau de Bord Régional, Bilan annuel. The portal shows 2026-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
